comments.author: @RidoDrago
comments.text: Get your agility up so you can dash in air = double jump + dash towards the boss when he casts the spikes, double jump + dash to the side when he does ground poison. When he flies up, the damage of the initial raining poison blasts do more damage then standing on a poison puddle created by one. So move from the orange/red circles aka poison blasts before they hit, then, move on to the poison puddle it leaves behind (if there is no open safe space at all) and move to a safer zone.
